Assistant Site Engineer Job at VAVA Projects




        
    

        
        VAVA Project is a construction and property development operation under the broader VAVA Group, involving the development and management of residential and commercial properties, project sites, facilities, and related operational activities. From the work you have shared, the project has a significant focus on construction-site operations, architecture, engineering, security, procurement, administration, and human resource management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Site Engineer

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key areas of the VAVA Project
     

            
    




	Project & Construction Operations: Management of construction sites, contractors, artisans, engineers, architects, materials, equipment, and general site activities.
	Human Resources: Recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave administration, confirmation, performance appraisal, employee relations, disciplinary procedures, and exit processes.
	Site Security: Security personnel management, site access control, incident investigations, security reports, and protection of company property and materials.
	Architecture & Engineering: Architectural design, technical drawings, site supervision, engineering activities, inspections, and coordination among project professionals.
	Project Facilities: Management of project accommodations, offices, storage areas, equipment, vehicles, and other facilities required for project execution.


Salary
N200,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

iOS Developer Job at Conclase Consulting




        
    

        
        At Conclase Consulting, we provide top notch IT solutions and support services to help you transform your business into an Intelligent Enterprise, redefine the customer experience, deliver a step change in productivity, and inspire total workforce engagement to achieve game-changing outcomes.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: iOS Developer

Job Location: Lagos

Role Description
     

            
    




	The iOS Developer will work on-site in Ikeja under a contract arrangement, collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to build and maintain high-quality iOS mobile applications.
	Day-to-day responsibilities include designing and implementing new app features, writing clean and efficient Swift/Objective-C code, integrating APIs and third-party libraries, and optimizing applications for performance and reliability.
	The role involves troubleshooting issues, fixing bugs, participating in code reviews, and ensuring adherence to best practices and security standards.
	The iOS Developer will also contribute to technical documentation, support release cycles, and work with stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver user-focused solutions.


Qualifications


	Strong proficiency in iOS Development and iOS frameworks for building native mobile applications.
	Hands-on experience in Mobile Application Development, including designing, coding, testing, and deploying Mobile Applications.
	Solid background in Software Development principles, including object-oriented programming, version control (e.g., Git), and secure coding practices.
	Familiarity with App Store submission processes, CI/CD pipelines, and performance optimization for iOS apps.
	Ability to work on-site in Ikeja, collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
	Experience using swift is a must
	Banking or fintech experience is a must
	Experience with RESTful APIs, JSON, and mobile UI/UX best practices; prior work in startup or fast-paced environments is an advantage.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Logistics and Warehouse Manager",
  "description": "Sundry Foods is an integrated food services company founded in 2003 and operating in major cities in Nigeria. We are bringing our now trademark great tasting ready-to-eat food and quality services to thousands of people and institutions daily through its chain and network of restaurants, bakeries and other catering facilities.

We are proud to own and operate one of Africa&rsquo;s best restaurant and bakery chains and we pride ourselves on our ability to consistently deliver original food and service solutions whether in workplaces, schools and colleges, hospitals, joining even remote sites and different cultural environments using our team of young seasoned professionals and an entire workforce with a passion to deliver nothing but the best to every customer

We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Logistics and Warehouse Manager

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
